title: Fidelity measurement
description: One fidelity number. A measurement CANNOT be expressed without naming a panel and a reference capture — panel_ref and reference_ref are required and must resolve. Every row also carries a derived comparability.key; rows are only ever ranked against rows sharing that key. Rows measured by someone else are marked in provenance.measured_by and are never silently merged with ours.

status.description: pending = the artifact exists and is registered but no qualified number exists yet; metric.value must be null. superseded/retracted must name a successor or a reason in disclosures.

reference_ref.description: REQUIRED. The teacher capture. Its panel_ref must equal panel_ref above.

pipeline_ref.description: The stack that computed the number. For author-reported rows this may be a pipeline record with repository=null and roles=[end-to-end], describing the author's stack as far as it is known.

scope_digest.description: Echo of the candidate artifact's scope_digest, so a measurement row is self-describing in a table. The validator recomputes it from the artifact and rejects a mismatch.

direction.description: reference_to_candidate means KL(P_reference || Q_candidate). Our receipts spell this 'teacher_to_student'. The two KL directions are different numbers and are never pooled.

auxiliary_metrics.description: Secondary numbers from the SAME run over the SAME panel. Never a place to smuggle in a number from a different panel.

method.description: 'none' means no interval was computed and none is claimed. 'unknown' is only legal for non-self-measured rows. 'window_block_bootstrap_bca' is the joint standard's interval: resample WINDOWS with replacement, B=5000, seed 20260829, bias-corrected and accelerated.

interval_kind.description: Which interval the ci95_low/high endpoints are. BCa and percentile are different intervals from the same bootstrap; say which.

cluster_unit.description: The resampling/clustering unit. On this panel the window is the real unit: there are only 3-4 source documents, so a document-clustered interval is indicative at best.

se_naive.description: SE of the mean ignoring clustering. Published so the design effect is visible, never as the quoted SE.

se_clustered.description: Cluster-robust SE at cluster_unit: sqrt(g/(g-1) * sum_c (T_c - n_c*mean)^2) / N.

deff.description: (se_clustered / se_naive)^2. On this panel it runs 21-105, i.e. the naive SE understates by 4.6x to 10x.

sigma_run.description: Sample stddev (ddof=1) of per-cold-run means over the COMMON window set. 0.0 is a legitimate value and means the kernel path is deterministic.

sigma_run_runs.description: How many cold runs sigma_run came from. Two runs give |delta|/sqrt(2) with one degree of freedom; the joint protocol asks for at least three.

se_total.description: hypot(se_clustered, sigma_run). Quote this, with both parts shown, whenever sigma_run/se_clustered > 0.2.

estimator.description: How the number was computed. Two of these fields — accumulation_dtype and stack_relation — are load-bearing for comparability and feed the comparability key.

accumulation_dtype.description: The dtype the per-token KL sum accumulated in. fp32 accumulation over 10M positions is a materially different estimator from fp64.

stack_relation.description: same_stack = reference and candidate logits produced by the same runtime and code path. cross_stack = they were not (e.g. vLLM capture vs a replayed packed reader). cross_stack carries a known bias and REQUIRES the bias block.

head_policy.description: Whether the candidate's own lm_head was used, or a single shared head was applied to both sides' hidden states.

vocab_masking_policy.description: Whether the padded lm_head columns were masked out of BOTH sides before the log-softmax. GLM-5.3-Flash stores 154880 columns for a 154856-token vocabulary, so 24 columns are untrained padding. brandonmusic's protocol masks them; every malaiwah number published before 2026-08-29 does not. The measured effect on a real teacher window is +7.2e-9 to +7.4e-9 RELATIVE (about 1e-10 nats), stable across shared-head and quantized-head students and across KLD 4.8e-5 to 1.0 nats, which is why this is a disclosed estimator property and NOT a comparability key input: it cannot move a comparison. Record it honestly; do not subtract anything.

padded_columns_masked.description: How many stored-vocabulary columns were masked out. 0 or null with vocab_masking_policy=full_stored_vocab; 24 for this model when masking.

determinism.description: Typed determinism evidence. The registry's hard-won rule is encoded here: identity of a RECEIPT FILE or a container/tarball proves nothing about numerics, because report files embed timestamps, paths and run indices and differ across bit-identical runs. Only TENSOR CONTENT hashes (tokenwise KL arrays, logits tensors) or a sealed tokenwise digest may support an identical_across_runs claim.

run_means.description: One entry per run. When present its length must equal run_count.

identical_across_runs.description: null = not assessed. true requires content-level evidence, see evidence_kind.

evidence_kind.description: What was compared across runs. receipt_file_sha256 and container_or_archive_sha256 are listed so contributors can record them honestly, and are BLOCKED by the conditionals below from ever supporting a determinism claim.

evidence_hashes.description: The distinct content hashes observed. For a bitwise-identical 5-run set this array has exactly one element.

allOf.description: A determinism claim needs content-level evidence and exactly one distinct content hash.
Receipt-file and archive hashes can never back a determinism claim.
Equal run means are weak evidence: they may be recorded but never asserted as bitwise identity.

measurement_scope.description: Which part of the panel this number actually covers. A subset is legal and sometimes necessary; a subset silently presented as the whole panel is the failure mode this block exists to prevent.

position_filter.description: e.g. 'all', or a named filter applied before averaging.

scope_name.description: A named sub-scope of the panel, e.g. 'panel25' (all sealed windows) or 'clean17' (the windows surviving the calibration-overlap scan). Two rows on different scope_names are NOT comparable, even on the same panel: excluding contaminated windows moves different quants in different directions.

max_retained_fraction.description: Highest overlap fraction among the RETAINED windows. If this sits just under the threshold the scope is threshold-sensitive and the threshold needs justifying.

provenance.description: WHO produced this number, and whether anyone else has reproduced it. measured_by is enumerated and mandatory; independently_verified is a SEPARATE flag and is never implied by measured_by.

measured_by.description: self-measured = the registry maintainer ran the measurement and holds the receipt. author-reported = the artifact's own publisher reported it. third-party-reported = anyone else.

independently_verified.description: true only when a party OTHER than the measurer reproduced the number on the same panel and reference. Never set true merely because we trust the source.

sources.description: At least one. For self-measured rows at least one must be a receipt_file/hf_file/github_file WITH a sha256.

receipt_schema.description: The receipt family the row was derived from, e.g. quant-pipeline.glm53-packed-student-kld-five-cold-run.v1.

stack_fingerprint_sha256.description: sha256 of the run's stack-fingerprint.json (malaiwah.stack-fingerprint.v1): engine build + git sha, enforce_eager/cudagraph state, attention backend, kernel knobs, env pins, container image digest, pip-freeze digest. OPTIONAL and provenance-only: rows predating 2026-08-29 lack it, and it does not enter the comparability key or any invariant yet.

comparability.description: The derived grouping key. Tables in this registry are grouped by comparability.key and never merged across keys. key_inputs is the human-readable expansion; the validator recomputes key from it and cross-checks each input against the referenced records.

key.description: cmp-- + first 16 hex of sha256 over the canonical join of key_inputs values with '|' in the declared field order.

class.description: strict = self-measured, same-stack, sealed panel, sealed or fully-hashed candidate, no comparability-affecting disclosure. Everything else is advisory. Advisory rows are shown in the same table only when the key matches, and always visually marked.

floor_measurement_ref.description: The same-stack self-consistency floor on this panel. A cross-stack number minus this floor is the only defensible way to read it.

usable_as_floor.description: Optional. false means this row may never be named as another row's comparability.bias.floor_measurement_ref (BIAS-007). Carried from the submission when the producing tool declared it; null means it was never declared, which is not the same as true.

by_domain.description: Per-domain stratified results. Quantization damage is NOT uniform across domains -- brandonmusic measured 1.50x / 1.97x / 1.65x NVFP4-over-EXL3 ratios on general / legal / code-agentic, so a single-corpus mean hides where a codec actually hurts. The domains must partition the scored positions of measurement_scope.

interval_method.description: Which procedure produced ci95_low/high. 'delta_t_log' is what this registry publishes for a stratum: a Student-t interval on log(mean) with the delta-method SE, exponentiated back. Non-negative by construction; measured 92.0% coverage at g=5-7 where BCa measures 81.3%; and it uses NO resample stream, so it cannot share Monte-Carlo error with the stratum beside it (STAT-17) and cannot blow up on a degenerate resample the way bootstrap-t does -- on the real k8/clean17/axis2_legal cell bootstrap-t returns an upper endpoint 18x the estimate from five ordinary windows.

bootstrap_seed.description: The seed THIS domain was bootstrapped with. Domains must not share one: at equal window counts a shared seed gives identical resample index streams across domains, so the intervals share their Monte-Carlo error (measured |r| up to 0.57) -- and arbitrarily, since it pairs domain A's k-th window with domain B's k-th, which are unrelated windows (STAT-17).

df.description: Degrees of freedom of the t critical value: windows - 1.

t_critical.description: The two-sided 97.5% Student-t quantile at df. Published so the endpoints can be re-derived by hand from mean, se_clustered-free delta SE and this number; at g=5 it is 2.7764, not the normal's 1.9600, and approximating it would understate the interval by 42%.

protocol.description: The frozen protocol file this row was produced under. Two hashes, deliberately: file_sha256 is byte-level provenance (brandonmusic's rule), scoring_sha256 is the hash of the canonicalised scoring-relevant subset. His own campaign published three different file hashes because the file was hand-edited twice to add identity blocks that changed no scoring rule; the scoring hash is invariant to exactly that, so two rows with equal scoring_sha256 are comparable even when the file hash moved.

allOf.description: A published row must have a value; a pending row must not.
We do not claim to have measured something without knowing our own estimator.
A reported row is never strict and must disclose that it is reported.
Cross-stack estimation carries a mandatory, typed bias block and an advisory class.

disclosures.description: A cross-stack row must name its hazard: cross_stack_capture when the two sides came from different runtimes of the same engine family, cross_engine_capture when they came from different inference engines entirely.

allOf.description: A subset row must say so in both places.
independently_verified=true must name the verifier and the method.
A strict row cannot carry any comparability-affecting disclosure.
JOINT-001: a bootstrap interval must say what it resampled, how many times, with what seed, and must carry endpoints.
JOINT-002: se_total is only meaningful beside its two parts.
JOINT-003: sigma_run needs at least two cold runs and must agree with determinism.run_count.
JOINT-004: a named sub-scope that is not the full panel must say so in covers_full_panel, so no reader can mistake it for the panel mean.
JOINT-005: a calibration-overlap scan result belongs to a named scope.
JOINT-006: a per-domain table must carry its interval kind wherever it quotes endpoints.
